title: The Sticky Note Rule
goal: Robots forget. We write a sticky note so they remember what we like.
mascot_lines: Robots like Claude have short memories.
We write a sticky note (grown-ups call it CLAUDE.md).
On it we put: I like X. I do NOT like Y.
Stack the sticky notes in the right order!

payload.prompt: Build the sticky note. Drag the words into the right order.
